current_round.prompt:
From: Buddy Williams <buddy.williams@insurity.com>
Subject: Refine goal-agent stalls ~15 min on completion signal �X invalid no_change_needed outcome triggers stop-hook retry loop

Body:
Team,

  Heads-up on a Refine failure mode we hit on run 8082 (node BO2LNXNEVO03) that looks like a hang but isn't.

  Symptom: A goal agent went silent for ~900 seconds with no output, then died. It looks like a network/compute hang or a stuck build.

  Actual cause: The agent had already finished the work successfully �X solution built clean (0 errors, 0 StyleCop warnings), Systema.Sims.Data.Claims.Tdd 3/3 and Api.Tdd 385/385 passing. It
  then tried to emit its Refine completion signal and got stuck in a schema-rejection loop:

  �k Refine rejected your completion signal: does not match the required schema: implementation_evidence.checklist[2].outcome: unknown variant "no_change_needed", expected one of completed,
  �k deviated, rejected, blocked. (replacement attempt 1 of 3).

  The agent used outcome: "no_change_needed", which is not a valid value in the goal-agent signal schema �X that value only exists in the code-review/ReportFindings schema, and the agent
  conflated the two. Each rejection forces a rewrite and re-runs the stop hook (~3m46s per cycle, visible in the logs as repeated running stop hook �P 3m 46s / Cooked for 3m 46s). Three retry
  attempts �� ~4 min each, with no user-visible output in between, is where the ~15 minutes went. It never produced a valid signal, so the process ended as .log.failed.

  What it is NOT:
  - Not a network or compute hang.
  - Not disk �X the "No space left on device" line in older run logs is a July incident; disk is currently at 44% used / 8% inodes.
  - Not the build or tests �X those were green before the loop started.

  Two things worth fixing on the Refine side:
  1. Fail fast on invalid enum. An unknown outcome variant should be rejected immediately, not put through 3�� full stop-hook cycles (~12 min wasted per occurrence). The stop hook shouldn't run
  on a signal that fails basic schema validation.
  2. Enum mismatch across schemas. no_change_needed is valid in the review/findings schema but not the goal-agent completion schema. Either align the enums or make the rejection message name
  the exact allowed values up front (it does list them �X but the agent still needs the schemas to stop diverging).


�w�wAlso seen in the same run (separate issue):�wworking-tree�wcollisions�wskipped�wthe�wcheckout�wsync�w�X�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w�w
  Entry 'Modules/Claims/Systema.Sims/.../ClaimBiz.cs' would be overwritten by merge �X leaving the integration delta "staged-reverse until repair_pending_checkout_sync succeeds." Not the cause
  of the stall, but the human checkout won't cleanly reflect the integrated change until that repair runs.

  Practical takeaway: If you see a goal agent go quiet for ~15 min and then fail, check run/<id>/processes/goal-agent-*.stdout.log.failed for a "rejected your completion signal" loop before
  assuming an infrastructure hang. The underlying task may already be complete.

  Thanks,
  Buddy
